item.title: Rendimientos en EEUU suben porque inflación y subida del petróleo refuerzan apuesta a alzas de tasas
item.description: Los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos subían el jueves después de que se conocieron datos de inflación que impulsaron las expectativas de un alza de las tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal la próxima semana, mientras que el repunte de los precios del petróleo también avivó el temor inflación.
item.dc:creator: Sinead Carew
item.content:encoded: Los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos subían el jueves después de que se conocieron datos de inflación que impulsaron las expectativas de un alza de las tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal la próxima semana, mientras que el repunte de los precios del petróleo también avivó el temor inflación. El rendimiento del bono del Tesoro a 10 años cotizaba en máximos de casi tres años, mientras que los de los a 30 años tocaron picos de 19 años y los de los bonos a dos años alcanzaron sus niveles más altos en más de dos años. El índice de precios al productor (IPP) de Estados Unidos aumentó en agosto, en línea con las expectativas, en términos mensuales, en un contexto de repunte del costo de los productos energéticos. En los 12 meses a agosto, el IPP avanzó un 5,4%, frente a las expectativas de consenso, que se situaban en el 5,3%. Los precios de la energía subieron un 4,2% en el mes, tras dos meses consecutivos de descensos, y los precios al por mayor de los alimentos registraron un ligero repunte del 0,1% tras haber caído un 0,9% en julio. Tras la publicación de los datos, los operadores apostaban por una probabilidad de aproximadamente el 70% de que la Fed suba las tasas 25 puntos básicos en su reunión del 15 al 16 de septiembre, frente al 62% anterior, según los datos de probabilidades de tasas de interés de LSEG. El rendimiento de los bonos de referencia estadounidenses a 10 años subía 8,48 puntos básicos, al 4,922%, alcanzando sus niveles más altos desde noviembre de 2023. El rendimiento de los bonos a 30 años subía 6,51 puntos básicos, al 5,3511%, tras alcanzar un máximo del 5,3543%, su nivel más alto desde junio de 2007. El rendimiento de los bonos a dos años, que suele evolucionar con las expectativas sobre las tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal, ganaba 9,12 puntos básicos, al 4,518%, alcanzando sus niveles más altos desde julio de 2024. Un indicador muy seguido de la curva de rendimientos del Tesoro, que mide la diferencia entre los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro a dos y a diez años, se situaba en 40,2 puntos básicos positivos. El reporte del índice de precios al consumo de agosto se publicará el viernes. El próximo gran acontecimiento es una emisión pública de 22.000 millones de dólares en bonos a 30 años, prevista para el jueves por la tarde. Anteriormente, el Banco Central Europeo subió las tasas de interés por segunda vez este año en una medida ampliamente anunciada el jueves, con la esperanza de frenar el aumento de la inflación impulsado por el incremento de los costos energéticos derivado de la guerra con Irán.

item.title: France L'Insee abaisse sa prévision de croissance pour 2026, désormais vue à 0,4%
item.description: L'Insee a annoncé jeudi une forte révision à la baisse de sa prévision de croissance pour la France cette année, la ramenant à +0,4% contre une estimation de +0,7% retenue à ce stade par le gouvernement, qui va toutefois actualiser ses projections à la baisse vendredi.
item.dc:creator: Leigh Thomas
item.content:encoded: L'Insee a annoncé jeudi une forte révision à la baisse de sa prévision de croissance pour la France cette année, la ramenant à +0,4% contre une estimation de +0,7% retenue à ce stade par le gouvernement, qui va toutefois actualiser ses projections à la baisse vendredi. La précédente prévision, datant de juin, de l'Insee, qui note que le déclin du pouvoir d'achat des Français pèse sur la consommation et que les entreprises réfrènent leurs investissements, était de 0,7%. En 2025, le produit intérieur brut (PIB) de la France, deuxième économie de la zone euro, avait progressé de 0,9%. L'assombrissement des perspectives de l'économie française met presque hors de portée l'objectif de déficit budgétaire 2026 de 4,9% - contre 5,0% en 2025 - que s'est fixé le gouvernement. Ce dernier, qui prépare le projet de loi de finances pour 2027 en vue d'une présentation au conseil des ministres d'ici la fin du mois, va vraisemblablement également être contraint d'annoncer une révision à la baisse de son objectif de déficit budgétaire vendredi. Sur une base trimestrielle, l'Insee prévoit une légère hausse du PIB sur le second semestre, +0,1% au troisième trimestre et +0,2% au quatrième, après une contraction de l'activité au premier trimestre et une [USN:L8N44P0EL TEXT:"croissance nulle"] au deuxième. La faible activité au troisième trimestre est notamment la conséquence des canicules à répétition qui ont marqué l'été et d'une sécheresse record, phénomènes qui ont pesé sur la production agricole. PRUDENCE DES CONSOMMATEURS ET DES ENTREPRISES D'après l'Insee, l'inflation en normes harmonisées IPCH devrait passer d'un taux de 2,7% en rythme annuel en août à +3,1% en décembre, le niveau moyen étant vu à +2,3% pour l'ensemble de l'année. La Banque centrale européenne (BCE) a, comme prévu, relevé jeudi ses taux directeurs [USN:L8N4520Z0 TEXT:"pour la deuxième fois cette année"], la poursuite du conflit au Moyen-Orient menaçant de maintenir l'inflation au-dessus de l'objectif pendant une période plus longue. Au vu de cette hausse de prix et d'une absence de croissance des salaires, la consommation des ménages ne devrait augmenter que de 0,3% cette année. Cette progression serait uniquement le fait de ménages puisant dans leur épargne, étant donné que le pouvoir d'achat est vu en repli de 0,4% cette année. Cette faiblesse de la consommation et la hausse des taux d'intérêt vont peser sur le sentiment des entreprises, avec des investissements de ces dernières vus en recul de 0,3%, le conflit entre l'Iran et les Etats-Unis, dont aucune issue à court terme ne semble en vue, ajoutant un facteur d'incertitudes. Dans ce contexte, le secteur privé devrait perdre 52.000 emplois sur l'ensemble de 2026, ce qui fera passer le taux de chômage français à 8,6% d'ici la fin de l'année contre 8,0% fin 2025.

item.title: Operadores elevam apostas em alta de juros pelo Fed após dados de inflação
item.description: Os operadores de mercado apostavam nesta quinta-feira que há uma probabilidade um pouco maior de que o Federal Reserve aumente a taxa de juros em sua reunião da próxima semana, após a divulgação do primeiro dos relatórios de inflação desta semana.
item.dc:creator: Ann Saphir
item.content:encoded: Os operadores de mercado apostavam nesta quinta-feira que há uma probabilidade um pouco maior de que o Federal Reserve aumente a taxa de juros em sua reunião da próxima semana, após a divulgação do primeiro dos relatórios de inflação desta semana. Os dados mostraram que os preços ao produtor nos EUA [USN:ZRN00EJES TEXT:"subiram"] 5,4% nos 12 meses até agosto, e os pedidos semanais de auxílio-desemprego no país indicaram que o mercado de trabalho permanece estável. Embora o aumento geral dos preços no atacado tenha estado em linha com as projeções dos economistas, detalhes do Índice de Preços ao Produtor sugeriram que parte da recente desaceleração da inflação está sendo revertida, à medida que as hostilidades renovadas no Oriente Médio prejudicam a distribuição global de petróleo e o aumento dos investimentos em IA impulsiona a demanda por eletrônicos. Os dados mostraram que os preços pagos pelos produtores por transporte e armazenamento dispararam em agosto, assim como os preços dos serviços hospitalares e das passagens aéreas. Antes dos dados divulgados nesta quinta-feira, os operadores estimavam cerca de 65% de chance de um aumento de 0,25 ponto percentual na taxa de juros na reunião do Fed de 15 a 16 de setembro. Essa probabilidade é agora vista como mais próxima de 70%, com base no preço dos contratos de juros futuros negociados no CME Group. Até o final do ano, o Fed quase certamente terá realizado um, se não dois, aumentos nas taxas de juros, segundo indicam os preços de mercado. PREÇOS AO CONSUMIDOR EM DESTAQUE Um relatório sobre a inflação dos preços ao consumidor, previsto para a sexta-feira, completará o quadro da inflação para as autoridades do Fed, que debatem se a taxa de juros de referência está exercendo pressão suficiente sobre a inflação para levá-la à meta de 2%. A inflação vem ficando acima da meta do Fed há 5 anos e meio. O Fed mantém sua taxa de juros de referência na faixa de 3,50% a 3,75% desde dezembro. “Com os dados do PPI (Índice de Preços ao Produtor) ainda parecendo relativamente elevados, parece provável que o Fed aumente as taxas este ano, mesmo que não tome essa decisão neste mês”, escreveram analistas da Capital Economics. Quanto à possibilidade de o banco central agir na próxima semana, eles afirmaram: “isso ainda depende do número mais importante do CPI(sigla em inglês para Índice de Preços ao Consumidor) básico, a ser divulgado amanhã”. O Fed tem como meta uma inflação de 2%, medida pela variação em 12 meses do Índice de Preços de Despesas de Consumo Pessoal (PCE), um indicador que pode ser estimado assim que os dados do CPI e do PPI estiverem disponíveis. Na quinta-feira, os analistas estavam divididos quanto à possibilidade de os dados do PPI empurrarem a inflação do PCE para um patamar alto o suficiente a ponto de forçar o Fed a agir na próxima semana. O Banco Central Europeu elevou suas taxas de juros de referência na manhã desta quinta-feira para conter a inflação decorrente da guerra no Irã, que empurrou os preços dos futuros do petróleo Brent para acima de US$100 o barril.

item.title: Trump administration proposes waiving grace period for H-1B holders after job loss
item.description: The Trump administration has proposed eliminating a 60-day grace period that allows certain immigrants, including skilled workers on H-1B visas, to stay in the United States and find a new sponsor after losing their job, according to a government notice posted online Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Susan Heavey
item.content:encoded: The Trump administration has proposed eliminating a 60-day grace period that allows certain immigrants, including skilled workers on H-1B visas, to stay in the United States and find a new sponsor after losing their job, according to a government notice posted online Thursday. Under the planned rule change, published in the Federal Register by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security, those with [USN:L1N44M0MZ TEXT:"H-1B"] and certain other temporary work visas would have to leave the country as soon as their employment ends — a potential blow to top American tech companies that rely heavily on foreign workers. It is the latest step by U.S. President Donald Trump to limit legal migration since returning to office in January 2025. His administration has also introduced [USN:L1N44H0LJ TEXT:"higher visa fees"] for skilled workers and recently [USN:L8N44S1Z3 TEXT:"paused immigrant visa appointments"] at U.S. missions around the world while it implements a new training program. Companies impacted by the change could see some disruption, DHS wrote in its proposal, but it said the jobs could go to American workers instead. In some situations, immigrant workers who leave could potentially reapply if their employer petitions for them, it added. "DHS presumes that they will either offer the same jobs to equally qualified U.S. workers or go through the I-129 petition process depending on their workforce requirement," the notice said. The 60-day grace period, in place since 2017, allows foreign workers time to find another U.S. job or get their affairs in order — whether selling a home or pulling children out of school — before leaving the country. H-1B visas, established by Congress in 1990, are especially critical for tech companies seeking talent from India and China, allowing them to fill roles where there is sometimes a lack of qualified U.S. workers. Consultancy companies such as Deloitte, PwC and Ernst & Young as well as outsourcing giants like Tata Consultancy Services TCS.NS , Infosys INFY.NS , HCL Tech HCLT.NS and LTIMindtree LTIM.NS are [USN:L3N3V90SB TEXT:"top H-1B sponsors"]. Lawyers for Berardi Immigration Law, which specializes in business-related immigration issues, said the move would "sharply compress the timeline HR teams have to manage layoffs and offboarding for foreign national employees." If implemented, the change would also apply to E-1 international trader visa holders; E-2 commercial vehicle operator visa holders; L-1 short-term work for executives or managers with international companies; O-1 visas for people "with an extraordinary ability" in science, sports or the arts; and TN professional workers. It also would impact H-1B1 skilled worker visa holders from Singapore and Chile and E-3 specialty worker visa holders from Australia. The rule is subject to a two-month public comment period before it can be enacted into law.

item.title: Report: Pats WR A.J. Brown believed to have high-ankle sprain
item.description: New England Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown is believed to have sustained a high-ankle sprain in Wednesday night's season opener, NFL Network reported Thursday morning.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: New England Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown is believed to have sustained a high-ankle sprain in Wednesday night's season opener, NFL Network reported Thursday morning. X-rays were negative for a fracture for the three-time Pro Bowl wideout, who will have an MRI on Thursday to determine the severity of the injury. Brown walked off the field with a right ankle injury on New England's opening possession of the second half in the Patriots' 13-10 loss to the host Seattle Seahawks. The Patriots announced Brown was questionable to return to the game. He did not, and head coach Mike Vrabel did not offer an update in his post-game press conference. Brown was targeted by a third-down pass from Drake Maye, but Seahawks nickel cornerback Nehemiah Pritchett deflected the pass to force a punt. Pritchett's knee landed on the outside of Brown's ankle, which twisted inward as he went to the ground. Brown removed his right cleat and entered the blue medical tent on the sideline as the Patriots added a field goal to go ahead 10-0 in the third quarter. Acquired from the Philadelphia Eagles via trade in early June, Brown had three receptions for a team-high 26 yards in the first half. Brown, 29, was selected second-team All-Pro with the Eagles in 2022, 2023 and 2024. He has 527 receptions for 8,055 yards and 56 touchdowns in 106 career games (98 starts) with the Tennessee Titans (2019-21), Eagles (2022-25) and Patriots. --Field Level Media

item.title: Apresentador da ABC diz que entrevista com candidato de oposição ao Senado dos EUA não será transmitida pela emissora
item.description: O apresentador do programa de entrevistas noturno da emissora de TV norte-americana ABC, Jimmy Kimmel, disse que uma entrevista com o candidato democrata ao Senado pelo Estado norte-americano do Texas, James Talarico, realizada nesta quinta-feira, será transmitida no YouTube e não pela emissora, citando ameaças da Comissão Federal de Comunicações dos EUA (FCC).
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: O apresentador do programa de entrevistas noturno da emissora de TV norte-americana ABC, Jimmy Kimmel, disse que uma entrevista com o candidato democrata ao Senado pelo Estado norte-americano do Texas, James Talarico, realizada nesta quinta-feira, será transmitida no YouTube e não pela emissora, citando ameaças da Comissão Federal de Comunicações dos EUA (FCC). Em janeiro, a FCC, liderada pelos republicanos, afirmou que os programas de entrevistas diurnos e noturnos não são mais considerados programas de notícias “autênticos”, isentos das regras de tempo igualitário que exigem que eles concedam tempo de transmissão aos candidatos adversários. Kimmel observou que, há décadas, os programas de entrevistas têm liberdade para entrevistar candidatos políticos sem estarem sujeitos a essas regras. Talarico está concorrendo no Texas contra o procurador-geral republicano Ken Paxton em uma disputa que pode decidir o controle do Senado dos EUA em novembro. Kimmel lembrou que já havia entrevistado o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, quando ele era candidato, em 2016. “Agora que ele é presidente, a FCC dele me ameaçou, ameaçou nosso programa, ameaçou nossa emissora ABC, nossas afiliadas e nossas emissoras locais, com base em simples decisões editoriais tradicionais — convites a convidados que, ao que parece, eles não gostam”, disse Kimmel na transmissão de quarta-feira. A ABC se recusou a comentar. A FCC não se pronunciou imediatamente. O presidente da FCC, Brendan Carr, ordenou revisões antecipadas em abril das oito emissoras da ABC, de propriedade da Disney, embora as renovações das licenças não estivessem sujeitas a serem analisadas antes de outubro de 2028. A FCC não havia ordenado uma revisão antecipada em mais de 50 anos antes de abril. As revisões foram ordenadas um dia depois de Trump ter pedido à ABC que demitisse Kimmel. A Disney entrou com uma ação judicial em agosto para impedir as revisões antecipadas, alegando que Trump está tentando punir a emissora por causa de seu conteúdo. A FCC também está investigando o programa de entrevistas diurno da ABC “The View”, que discute política dos EUA, após afirmar que ele está sujeito às regras de tempo igualitário após uma entrevista com Talarico em janeiro. A Disney afirmou que, desde fevereiro, o programa não convidou nenhum candidato político para participar, citando a “campanha de pressão” da FCC. Em fevereiro, o ex-apresentador do programa noturno da CBS, Stephen Colbert, disse que os advogados da emissora o impediram de transmitir uma entrevista com Talarico em seu programa e, em vez disso, ele a exibiu no YouTube, onde já foi vista mais de 9,5 milhões de vezes. Trump tem instado repetidamente as emissoras a cancelarem programas de comédia ou notícias dos quais ele não gosta, ou que tenham feito piadas ou críticas a ele ou ao seu governo. Ele também pediu à FCC que retirasse as licenças das emissoras após criticar noticiários e outros programas. As emissoras de TV precisam de licenças da FCC para usar as ondas de rádio públicas. Embora a revogação de licenças seja extremamente rara, críticos afirmam que a ameaça de perder uma licença pode pressionar as emissoras e levantar preocupações sobre a interferência do governo nas decisões editoriais e de programação. As emissoras contam com ampla proteção da Primeira Emenda da Constituição dos EUA no que diz respeito às escolhas de programação. (Reportagem de David Shepardson)

item.title: Príncipe William lança campanha esportiva para prevenir o suicídio
item.description: O príncipe William, acompanhado por sua esposa Kate e por várias figuras de destaque do esporte britânico, lançou na quinta-feira uma nova iniciativa com o objetivo de ajudar o setor esportivo a desempenhar um papel mais significativo na prevenção do suicídio.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O príncipe William, acompanhado por sua esposa Kate e por várias figuras de destaque do esporte britânico, lançou na quinta-feira uma nova iniciativa com o objetivo de ajudar o setor esportivo a desempenhar um papel mais significativo na prevenção do suicídio. A questão da saúde mental e da prevenção do suicídio é uma das principais prioridades da campanha do herdeiro britânico. Em outubro passado, ele quase chorou ao discutir o impacto do suicídio com uma mulher cujo marido havia tirado a própria vida. “O esporte tem a capacidade de alcançar pessoas que talvez nunca cruzem a porta de um serviço de saúde mental”, disse William no estádio do clube de futebol Everton, por ocasião do Dia Mundial de Prevenção do Suicídio. A campanha conta com o apoio do capitão da seleção inglesa, Harry Kane, do ex-atacante Alan Shearer e dos medalhistas de ouro olímpicos Kelly Holmes e do casal de campeões de ciclismo Jason e Laura Kenny. Foi a aparição de maior destaque de William no Reino Unido desde que seu irmão, o príncipe Harry, a esposa e filhos voltaram a morar no país no mês passado. Os irmãos, que se afastaram desde que Harry se mudou para os Estados Unidos há seis anos e criticou publicamente a família real em entrevistas e em seu livro de memórias, já haviam feito campanhas juntos para aumentar a conscientização sobre questões de saúde mental. William descreveu o suicídio como um dos maiores desafios da sociedade e afirmou que preveni-lo é responsabilidade de todos. “Queremos iniciar um movimento no mundo do esporte”, disse ele. “Estamos pedindo um compromisso para criar ambientes onde as pessoas se sintam capazes de falar abertamente, onde pedir ajuda seja visto como um sinal de força e onde o apoio nunca esteja fora de alcance.” A iniciativa, chamada “On Your Side”, foi desenvolvida pela Royal Foundation, a organização beneficente fundada por William e Kate. Seu objetivo é ajudar as pessoas envolvidas no esporte a reconhecer sinais de alerta e apoiar aqueles que estão passando por dificuldades antes que cheguem a um ponto crítico.

item.title: FMI dice Argentina debe seguir fortaleciendo reservas, preservar ancla fiscal
item.description: El Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI) dijo el jueves que Argentina debe seguir fortaleciendo sus reservas, reducir riesgos financieros y preservar el ancla fiscal.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI) dijo el jueves que Argentina debe seguir fortaleciendo sus reservas, reducir riesgos financieros y preservar el ancla fiscal. El organismo dijo que el sistema bancario de Argentina es "bastante pequeño", por lo cual es importante que el país provea formas de canalizar crédito y ahorros hacia inversiones en el futuro. El FMI dijo que comenzará una misión en Argentina el 21 de septiembre para la tercera revisión del actual programa con el país sudamericano, el principal deudor del organismo.

item.title: FMI afirma que crescimento global está a caminho de atingir 3% em 2026, mas riscos seguem elevados
item.description: O Fundo Monetário Internacional (FMI) afirmou nesta quinta-feira que a economia global resistiu ao choque de energia causado pela guerra no Oriente Médio melhor do que o esperado e que a produção econômica global ainda deve crescer cerca de 3% em 2026, mas alertou que os riscos continuam elevados.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Fundo Monetário Internacional (FMI) afirmou nesta quinta-feira que a economia global resistiu ao choque de energia causado pela guerra no Oriente Médio melhor do que o esperado e que a produção econômica global ainda deve crescer cerca de 3% em 2026, mas alertou que os riscos continuam elevados. Julie Kozack, porta-voz do FMI, afirmou que os preços do petróleo e do gás continuam elevados e que o choque de energia decorrente da guerra ainda não terminou. As pressões da dívida global também estão aumentando e o processo de desinflação após a crise do custo de vida de 2022 estagnou, disse ela a repórteres. Kozack afirmou em uma coletiva de imprensa regular do FMI que as expectativas de inflação global aumentaram, mas permanecem bem ancoradas no longo prazo. (Reportagem de Andrea Shalal e Rodrigo Campos)

item.title: Wall Street cae tras dato de inflación al productor superior a lo esperado
item.description: Los principales índices de Wall Street bajaban el jueves, tras un informe de precios al productor en Estados Unidos que elevó las expectativas de un alza de tasas de interés este mes, mientras que la escalada del conflicto en Oriente Medio mantenía los precios del petróleo por encima de los 100 dólares el barril.
item.dc:creator: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Niket Nishant
item.content:encoded: Los principales índices de Wall Street bajaban el jueves, tras un informe de precios al productor en Estados Unidos que elevó las expectativas de un alza de tasas de interés este mes, mientras que la escalada del conflicto en Oriente Medio mantenía los precios del petróleo por encima de los 100 dólares el barril. * Los precios del crudo operaban por encima de los 100 dólares el barril, ensombreciendo las perspectivas para la bolsa y reforzando las expectativas de una subida de tasas este mes, ya que las rutas de suministro a través del estrecho de Ormuz y del mar Rojo siguen afectadas por una guerra que dura ya seis meses. * Como reflejo de ese aumento de los costos, un reporte del Departamento de Trabajo mostró que el Índice de Precios al Productor (IPP) avanzó un 5,4% en agosto en términos anualizados, una cifra algo superior al 5,3% que esperaban los economistas encuestados por Reuters. * Aunque el reporte del IPP suele recibir menos atención que el del Índice de Precios al Consumo (IPC), que se publicará el viernes, todos los indicadores económicos están siendo objeto de un mayor escrutinio desde que el banco central estadounidense dejó de publicar orientaciones sobre la política monetaria. * "Esperábamos que los datos fueran más moderados de lo previsto. No han sido lo suficientemente moderados", afirmó Jim Lebenthal, estratega jefe de renta variable de Cerity Partners. "Ahora esperamos que mañana el IPC nos dé una especie de golpe de suerte". * El rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro a dos años, que evoluciona en paralelo a las expectativas sobre tasas, se disparó al 4,516%, su nivel más alto desde 2024. * Los operadores ven ahora un 69,8% de probabilidades de que la Fed suba las tasas al menos en 25 puntos básicos la próxima semana, frente al 64% previo al reporte, según la herramienta FedWatch de la CME. * A las 1359 GMT, el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) caía 312,92 puntos, o un 0,6%, a 52.067,74 unidades; el índice S&P 500 (.SPX) perdía 55,02 puntos, o un 0,72%, a 7.581,17 unidades; y el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) restaba 226,85 puntos, o un 0,86%, a 26.026,49 unidades.

item.title: What comes next in Italy's banking deal frenzy
item.description: The latest twist in Italy's banking takeover saga has pitted market leader Intesa Sanpaolo against the biggest winner of the shakeup so far, Monte dei Paschi di Siena (MPS).
item.dc:creator: Valentina Za, Gianluca Semeraro
item.content:encoded: The latest twist in Italy's banking takeover saga has pitted market leader Intesa Sanpaolo (ISP.MI) against the biggest winner of the shakeup so far, Monte dei Paschi di Siena (BMPS.MI) (MPS). With a less concentrated banking sector than France or Spain, Italy has seen a wave of bids and counterbids since late 2024 as lenders jockey for position amid a revival in dealmaking fuelled by stronger balance sheets and excess capital. The deal frenzy has baffled even seasoned observers, with MPS now pursuing a two-pronged defence strategy to try to fend off Intesa's takeover approach. Intesa on Thursday [USN:L8N4520OF TEXT:"secured shareholder"] approval for the share financing of its plan. Here's where things stand, and what might happen next. WHAT'S THE LATEST? The first merger wave has reshaped Italy's second-tier banking sector, which sits below industry giants Intesa and UniCredit (CRDI.MI) . A long-running political ambition to create a third major group has helped transform MPS, which was rescued by Rome in 2017 and reprivatised in 2023-2024, into an unlikely acquirer. Last year, MPS bought bigger rival Mediobanca and, through that deal, became the leading shareholder in Generali (GASI.MI) , Italy's biggest insurer, which both Intesa and UniCredit covet. After UniCredit [USN:L8N42Q05T TEXT:"built a 9% stake in Generali"] last year, Intesa [USN:L4N42G0DE TEXT:"launched"] its €35 billion ($41 billion) cash-and-shares bid for MPS in June. The deal would give Intesa roughly 13% of Generali, control of Mediobanca and half of MPS's branch network. Critical of Intesa's plan to break up its retail network, MPS initially explored a merger proposed by mid-sized peer Banco BPM (BAMI.MI) [USN:L1N42F03F TEXT:"hours before"] Intesa unveiled its offer. When [USN:L8N4422XY TEXT:"talks with BPM broke down"] last month, MPS responded with all-share bids for both BPM and wealth manager Banca Generali (BGN.MI) . MPS's Generali stake is now key to its [USN:L1N44H0NA TEXT:"defence strategy"]. The bank plans to use part of that holding to reward shareholders, who would receive €3 billion in cash as part of the mainly share-based offer from Intesa. Generali CEO Philippe Donnet has also emerged as an important ally for MPS boss Luigi Lovaglio, with [USN:L8N44O0FV TEXT:"the insurer now open"] to exploring commercial deals with the Tuscan bank. Generali, which competes with Intesa in life insurance, owns 50.2% of Banca Generali and could choose to tender its stake. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT? MPS shareholders are due to vote on the defence plan on October 29. Thursday's approval of Intesa's financing plans was widely expected. The real uncertainty now centres on the October vote. Investors remain cautious about MPS' €37 billion twin bids for BPM and Banca Generali, with shares in both targets trading below the offer values. Still, several people close to Intesa told Reuters the scheme had significantly complicated its takeover plans by creating uncertainty and confusing investors. WHAT'S THE COMPLICATION? Intesa is awaiting European Central Bank and antitrust approvals for its bid, with the tender offer expected to begin only after MPS shareholders vote on its defence plan. MPS investors could approve its twin bids and still choose to tender their shares into Intesa's offer. Intesa is counting on completing its offer by the end of December, before MPS has a chance to launch its own bids. COULD UNICREDIT MAKE A MOVE? UniCredit's 9% Generali stake has given it sway in the Intesa-MPS battle. Now that its two-year pursuit of Commerzbank (CBKG.DE) has left it with de facto control of the German lender, UniCredit could refocus on Italy, where it has so far failed to make a mark in the consolidation wave, bankers said. UniCredit CEO Andrea Orcel has said he may forego domestic acquisitions rather than overpay. Bankers don't expect Orcel to disrupt Intesa's plans directly, and instead view Banco BPM and Banca Generali as potential targets for UniCredit. WHAT'S THE GOVERNMENT'S STANCE? The government has maintained [USN:L8N44W0N8 TEXT:"a neutral position"] in the latest banking tussle and is not expected to participate in the October vote with its remaining 4.9% stake in MPS. ($1 = 0.8603 euros)

item.title: JD.com's Ceconomy concessions face criticism from rivals, sources say
item.description: JD.com's concessions to ease EU subsidy concerns about the Chinese e-commerce giant's $2.5 billion purchase of German electronics retailer Ceconomy have prompted criticism from competitors, people familiar with the matter told Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Yun Chee Foo
item.content:encoded: JD.com's (9618.HK) concessions to ease EU subsidy concerns about the Chinese e-commerce giant's $2.5 billion purchase of German electronics retailer Ceconomy (CECG.DE) have prompted criticism from competitors, people familiar with the matter told Reuters. They said the European Commission, which acts as the European Union's competition enforcer, informed JD.com earlier this week of the responses to [USN:L1N44H0JY TEXT:"concessions it offered"] last month. The Commission, which will decide on the deal by October 23, and JD.com declined to comment on the negative feedback, which will put pressure on JD.com to improve its concessions. Under its proposals, Ceconomy would access JD.com's European logistics capability and technological capability at market rates, one of the people said. Smaller rivals would also get access at fair and non-discriminatory rates. The EU antitrust watchdog is examining JD.com's proposed acquisition of Ceconomy under the Foreign Subsidies Regulation that targets unfair foreign state aid. Its preliminary review in May indicated that JD.com may have received foreign subsidies such as preferential financing, tax incentives and grants provided by entities possibly attributable to Beijing. The Commission underscored its misgivings by setting out specific concerns in July, which JD.com will have to address in order to gain approval for the deal.

item.title: Wachtell dealmaker jumps to Linklaters to bolster US buildout
item.description: Law firm Linklaters said on Thursday that it has hired longtime partner Mark Gordon from Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz, marking the latest departure from the New York firm amid a hot market for senior U.S. legal talent.
item.dc:creator: Sara Merken
item.content:encoded: Law firm Linklaters said on Thursday that it has hired longtime partner Mark Gordon from Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz, marking the latest departure from the New York firm amid a hot market for senior U.S. legal talent. Gordon will join Linklaters in November as managing partner of its Americas division and co-chair of global mergers and acquisitions, the London-founded firm said. His recent deals have included representing artificial decking maker AZEK in its [USN:L3N3Q602T TEXT:"$8.75 billion acquisition"] by fiber-cement maker James Hardie Industries last year, and drugmaker Alexion Pharmaceuticals in its [USN:L4N2IS05K TEXT:"$39 billion sale"] to AstraZeneca in 2021. Wachtell [USN:L6N43U13P TEXT:"lost"] a high-profile litigation team in July, with William Savitt, who co-chaired the firm's executive committee and litigation department, moving with five other partners to Gibson, Dunn & Crutcher. Sidley Austin said earlier this month that it brought on former Wachtell partner Deborah Paul to co-lead its tax practice. Restructuring partner Joshua Feltman left Wachtell for Kirkland & Ellis in April. Kirkland offered Feltman a pay package of $80 million over three years, according to the Financial Times, which cited people familiar with the matter. Wachtell spokespeople did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Gordon's exit and other recent departures. Linklaters is among a group of top UK-founded firms that have sought to grow their U.S. market share through aggressive hiring. “We have a clear ambition: to build a top-tier team in the U.S. as a core part of our global offering," Linklaters senior partner and chair Aedamar Comiskey said in a statement. Gordon was not immediately available for comment. He takes over the Americas leadership position from Tom McGrath, whose term ended, Linklaters said. He will work on the firm's U.S. growth alongside dealmaker George Casey, chair of the Americas and global chair of corporate, who [USN:L1N3DY1A7 TEXT:"joined"] Linklaters from Shearman & Sterling in 2024. The firm has [USN:L6N43M119 TEXT:"doubled its revenue"] and quadrupled profits over the past four years in the United States. Linklaters' other recent U.S. hires have included a litigation and sports team from Paul Weiss and Johnson & Johnson's global litigation leader, Erik Haas.

item.title: El sector de servicios de Brasil se mantiene estable en julio, aumentan señales de desaceleración
item.description: La actividad del sector de servicios de Brasil se mantuvo estable en julio con respecto al mes anterior, según datos publicados el jueves por la agencia de estadística IBGE, lo que no cumplió con las expectativas y refuerza los indicios de una desaceleración en la mayor economía de América Latina.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La actividad del sector de servicios de Brasil se mantuvo estable en julio con respecto al mes anterior, según datos publicados el jueves por la agencia de estadística IBGE, lo que no cumplió con las expectativas y refuerza los indicios de una desaceleración en la mayor economía de América Latina. El resultado mensual no alcanzó la previsión promedio de un aumento del 0,2% en una encuesta de Reuters a economistas. El sector registró un aumento interanual del 0,9% en julio, también por debajo de la previsión del 1,1% de la encuesta de Reuters. Los servicios, que representan alrededor del 70% de la economía brasileña, se han mantenido estancados desde principios de año, señaló el analista del IBGE Luiz Carlos Almeida. Un mercado laboral ajustado y las medidas de estímulo del Gobierno han respaldado el consumo, pero la política monetaria restrictiva sigue lastrando la actividad. La tasa de interés de referencia de Brasil, la Selic, se sitúa actualmente en el 14,0% tras cuatro recortes consecutivos de 0,25 puntos porcentuales. El economista sénior de Inter, André Valério, prevé que la moderación del crecimiento persista hasta 2027, lo que podría permitir al banco central continuar con los ajustes de la Selic. El economista de XP, Alexandre Maluf, citó los elevados costos de financiación y el aumento de la carga de la deuda de los hogares como principales limitaciones, a pesar de que un mercado laboral tenso respalda la demanda de los hogares.

item.title: Starlink rival Eutelsat plans OneWeb expansion after €1 billion satellite order
item.description: Satellite operator Eutelsat said on Thursday it will replenish and expand its OneWeb network through 2034 after the Franco-British operator signed a deal with Airbus for 229 additional low Earth orbit satellites.
item.dc:creator: Gianluca Lo Nostro
item.content:encoded: Satellite operator Eutelsat (ETL.PA) said on Thursday it will replenish and expand its OneWeb network through 2034 after the Franco-British operator signed a deal with Airbus (AIR.PA) for 229 additional low Earth orbit satellites. The new order, representing an investment of €1 billion ($1.16 billion), will be added to the 440 Airbus-built [USN:L6N3YD0FC TEXT:"satellites ordered"] in 2024 and 2025. Deliveries of those previous orders are expected to begin in the fourth quarter. After raising roughly €5 billion to weather the financial strain stemming from its $3.4 billion [USN:ASM000KMK TEXT:"merger with OneWeb"], Eutelsat's expansion plans aim to bolster the company's ambition of challenging Elon Musk's currently dominant Starlink. Eutelsat is considered strategically important by the French and British governments, because it operates the only low Earth orbit satellite network outside Starlink, providing secure communications and broadband internet services. The agreement extends Eutelsat's low Earth orbit fleet roadmap beyond [USN:L6N40I168 TEXT:"previous plans"], under which the company expected to spend about €2 billion to procure and launch the 440 satellites by 2030. OneWeb currently comprises more than 600 satellites, though CEO Jean-François Fallacher told Reuters in March that Eutelsat expected its fleet to exceed 1,000 "very soon". Starlink, meanwhile, has more than 11,000 satellites in orbit, although OneWeb requires far fewer to provide global coverage, because its satellites operate at a higher altitude and the company focuses on government, enterprise and telecom customers rather than mass-market consumers. The 229 additional satellites are intended to ensure service continuity until the commercial deployment of IRIS², the European Union's planned secure communications constellation of 348 satellites, expected to enter service around the end of the decade. In a separate announcement at the Paris space summit on Thursday, Eutelsat — also a SpaceX (SPCX.O) customer — said it had booked two Ariane launch missions to carry OneWeb satellites in 2027 and 2028. ($1 = 0.8611 euros)

item.title: IMF say global growth on track to reach 3% in 2026, but risks remain high
item.description: The IMF on Thursday said the global economy had weathered the energy shock caused by the war in the Middle East better than feared and global economic output was still expected to expand by about 3% in 2026, but it cautioned that risks remained high.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The IMF on Thursday said the global economy had weathered the energy shock caused by the war in the Middle East better than feared and global economic output was still expected to expand by about 3% in 2026, but it cautioned that risks remained high. Julie Kozack, spokesperson for the International Monetary Fund, said oil and gas prices remained high and the energy shock from the war was not over. Global debt pressures were also mounting and the disinflation process over the 2022 cost of living crisis had stalled, she told reporters. Kozack told a regular IMF briefing that global inflation expectations had risen but remain well-anchored over the longer run.

item.title: Finland risks strained power supply after Google AI deal, opposition warns
item.description: Finland should introduce a national permitting system for data centres to prevent the risk of power shortages and soaring energy prices, opposition parties said on Thursday following Google's announcement of a large new investment in the country.
item.dc:creator: Essi Lehto
item.content:encoded: Finland should introduce a national permitting system for data centres to prevent the risk of power shortages and soaring energy prices, opposition parties said on Thursday following Google's announcement of a [USN:L1N4510NH TEXT:"large new investment"] in the country. The Nordic region has for years been a [USN:L6N40I0Y8 TEXT:"magnet for data centres"] thanks to a cool climate, abundant low-carbon electricity and reliable power grids, but AI builders are now facing greater scrutiny from consumers and politicians. Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Google said on Wednesday it will spend at least €13 billion ($15.1 billion) on AI infrastructure in Finland over the next two years, its biggest European investment, including a deal for the supply of nuclear power. While data centres are welcome in Finland, the country must make sure there is enough electricity and transmission capacity to power them, Centre Party leader Antti Kaikkonen told Reuters. "A national permitting system for new data centre investments would be needed. At the moment, no one is really looking after the overall picture," said Kaikkonen, whose party is Finland's second-largest opposition group. The Social Democratic Party, which is leading in the polls ahead of an election due in April, said that while it welcomed data centre investments, it remains concerned about the implications for power demand. "It is particularly important that the availability of electricity is also examined as a broader internal security issue, so that people have enough energy and that it is priced at a level they can afford to use," Social Democratic lawmaker Niina Malm said. Google's deal included a 22-year purchase agreement for up to 50% of the energy output from Finland's Loviisa nuclear plant, helping extend the expected life of the plant until 2050, from a previous shutdown date in 2030. The company would also explore the development of new nuclear and renewable energy in Finland alongside utility Fortum (FORTUM.HE) , the two groups said. Finland's Prime Minister Petteri Orpo has said the Google deal will boost the country's economy and that electricity prices will remain under control. The government did not immediately respond to a request for comment. ($1 = 0.8604 euros)

item.title: Alcaldes de Inglaterra obtienen competencia para aplicar un impuesto turístico
item.description: Los alcaldes regionales de Inglaterra recibirán la competencia para aplicar un impuesto sobre las pernoctaciones, anunció el jueves el Gobierno británico, que sigue adelante con un impuesto turístico con el que el primer ministro, Andy Burnham, espera que contribuya a que el poder y el dinero salgan de Londres.
item.dc:creator: Andy Bruce
item.content:encoded: Los alcaldes regionales de Inglaterra recibirán la competencia para aplicar un impuesto sobre las pernoctaciones, anunció el jueves el Gobierno británico, que sigue adelante con un impuesto turístico con el que el primer ministro, Andy Burnham, espera que contribuya a que el poder y el dinero salgan de Londres. El "Impuesto sobre las Pernoctaciones", que suscitó críticas inmediatas por parte del sector hotelero, ofrece a los alcaldes la opción de gravar a los visitantes con un porcentaje del costo de su estancia. Burnham, que sustituyó a Keir Starmer como primer ministro en julio, considera que este impuesto es una forma de dotar de mayor autonomía financiera a los dirigentes locales. La semana pasada dijo que el impuesto entraría en vigor hacia finales del próximo ejercicio presupuestario, y se espera que los alcaldes presenten sus planes de gasto a principios de 2028. "Esta medida dará a los alcaldes la posibilidad de recaudar y reinvertir fondos allí donde más se necesiten", comentó Angela Rayner, secretaria de Estado de Vivienda, Comunidades y Gobierno Local. "Contribuirá a respaldar los servicios locales, los espacios públicos y las atracciones de las que dependen tanto los residentes como los visitantes, y las decisiones las tomarán las personas que mejor conocen su zona". UKHospitality, que representa al sector, dijo que esta medida perjudicaría a las familias británicas y aumentaría la burocracia. "Si se concede a los alcaldes la facultad de recaudar impuestos en un sector, tirarán de esa palanca hasta que se rompa", dijo el director ejecutivo Allen Simpson. Simpson citó un estudio de la consultora Oxford Economics que estima que un gravamen del 5%, si se aplicara plenamente para 2030, costaría unos 33.000 puestos de trabajo y reduciría la producción económica en 2.200 millones de libras (2.980 millones de dólares). El sector también argumenta que el sector hotelero británico ya paga un impuesto sobre las ventas del 20%, el doble de lo habitual en gran parte de Europa. Escocia ya ha dado un paso adelante en esta cuestión. Edimburgo puso en marcha en julio un impuesto del 5%, con un límite máximo de cinco noches. (1 dólar = 0,7381 libras)

item.title: Poland says it expects Russia will target its border crossings with Ukraine
item.description: Poland averted a threat to one of its border crossings with Ukraine overnight and expects its crossings will be targeted as Moscow strikes trade routes to try to weaken Kyiv economically, Prime Minister Donald Tusk said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Poland averted a threat to one of its border crossings with Ukraine overnight and expects its crossings will be targeted as Moscow strikes trade routes to try to weaken Kyiv economically, Prime Minister Donald Tusk said on Thursday. He spoke after drones hit [USN:L1N451040 TEXT:"a border crossing"] between Ukraine and Moldova in the southern region of Odesa, killing two people on Wednesday. "Last night, thanks to cooperation between our services and their Ukrainian counterparts, a direct threat to one of the border crossings was averted," Tusk told a press conference in the Slovak capital Bratislava. "As you know, Russia has already resorted to provocative attacks on border crossings - for instance, in Moldova. We expect similar actions targeting border crossings with Ukraine in other countries, including Poland." Russia did not immediately comment on Tusk's remarks. Tusk has repeatedly warned that countries on NATO's eastern flank need to be prepared for potential provocations from Russia, which invaded its smaller neighbour in 2022 and has been waging war in Ukraine since then. He said on Thursday that he had received "a fairly precise report directly from the CIA regarding possible events in the coming months - aligning with what I have been saying and warning about for months". "We must anticipate various scenarios; both Poland and all of Europe need to be prepared for different possibilities concerning the situation not only on the Russian-Ukrainian front but also along the EU’s eastern flank."

item.title: Monedas caen tras datos EEUU que refuerzan expectativas de alza de tasas de la Fed
item.description: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina anotaban pérdidas el miércoles, presionadas por un avance global del dólar tras datos que reforzaron las expectativas de un aumento en las tasas por parte de la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos (Fed), en su reunión de política monetaria de la próxima semana.
item.dc:creator: Froilan Romero
item.content:encoded: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina anotaban pérdidas el miércoles, presionadas por un avance global del dólar tras datos que reforzaron las expectativas de un aumento en las tasas por parte de la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos (Fed), en su reunión de política monetaria de la próxima semana. * Los operadores reforzaron sus apuestas a que la Fed subirá las tasas de interés a corto plazo en su reunión de la próxima semana después de que el primer informe clave sobre la inflación de esta semana revelara que los precios al productor subieron un 5,4% en los 12 meses hasta agosto. * Tras este dato, las probabilidades de que el banco central estadounidense eleve los tipos de interés en un cuarto de punto en su reunión del 15 al 16 de septiembre subieron en torno al 70%, según el precio de los contratos de futuros sobre fondos federales negociados en CME Group, desde un 65% previo. * Asimismo, el Departamento de Trabajo reportó que el número de estadounidenses que solicitaron prestaciones por desempleo descendió la semana pasada, lo que sugiere que los despidos se mantuvieron en niveles bajos y siguieron estabilizando el mercado laboral. * La atención de los mercados se centra ahora en los datos de agosto del índice de precios al consumidor (IPC) que se darán a conocer el viernes en Estados Unidos y que es considerado clave para la decisión de la Fed en materia de tasas de interés. * El índice dólar , que compara a la divisa frente a una canasta de seis monedas de primer orden, escalaba alrededor de un 0,2%. * Las bajas eran encabezadas por el peso chileno , , que cedía un 1,19%, a 939,00/939,30 por dólar, presionado, además, por una fuerte caída en los precios del cobre, el mayor envío del país. El peso argentino tocó su nivel mínimo intradiario en la sesión previa al marcar las 1.517,5 unidades para la venta. * En tanto, el índice bursátil Merval (.MERV) de la Bolsa de Buenos Aires avanzaba un 0,37%. * El peso colombiano perdía un 0,32% a 3.113 unidades por dólar y en la bolsa el índice accionario MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) caía un 0,14% a 2.580,41 puntos. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se depreciaba un 0,42% a 3,3700/3,3710 unidades por dólar. item.title: French economy set for only 0.4% growth this year, says INSEE
item.description: The French economy will grow markedly less this year than the government has anticipated as declining purchasing power weighs on consumer spending and firms rein in investment, the national statistics office forecast on Thursday, cutting its outlook.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The French economy will grow markedly less this year than the government has anticipated as declining purchasing power weighs on consumer spending and firms rein in investment, the national statistics office forecast on Thursday, cutting its outlook. The euro zone's second-largest economy is now expected to grow just 0.4% this year, down from INSEE's June forecast of 0.7% and less than half the 0.9% expansion recorded last year. That would fall short of the government's current 0.7% forecast, though it is set to revise its forecast on Friday as it prepares to send its 2027 budget bill to parliament at the end of the month. The weaker outlook makes France's current deficit-reduction target extremely difficult to reach. The government had aimed to narrow the fiscal deficit to 4.9% of economic output this year from 5.0% in 2025, but is also expected to revise that forecast on Friday. On a quarterly basis, INSEE forecast growth would only slightly pick up in the second half of the year after contracting in the first quarter and flat-lining in the [USN:L8N44P0AJ TEXT:"second quarter"]. With summer heatwaves and drought weighing on agriculture output, growth was seen at only 0.1% in the third quarter from the previous three months before picking up to 0.2% in the final quarter. CONSUMER AND CORPORATE CAUTION INSEE forecast inflation, using EU-harmonised data, would tick up from 2.7% in August to 3.1% by the end of the year, giving an average rate of 2.3% for the year. Higher prices and stagnant wage growth are expected to leave household purchasing power down 0.4% this year. Consumer spending is nevertheless forecast to increase by 0.3%, largely because households are expected to dip into their savings. Weak consumer demand and higher interest rates would meanwhile weigh on business investment, which was forecast to fall 0.3% this year as firms also contend with a difficult international context due to the war in the Middle East. Against that backdrop, the French economy is expected to lose 52,000 private sector jobs over the course of the year, pushing the unemployment rate to 8.6% by year-end, up from 8.0% a year earlier.

item.title: Agencia de EEUU ve más de 90% de probabilidad de El Niño muy intenso
item.description: El Niño se está intensificando, con una probabilidad superior al 90% de que haya un fenómeno muy intenso durante el otoño boreal y el invierno boreal de 2026-27 en el hemisferio norte, informó el jueves el Centro de Predicción Climática de Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Niño se está intensificando, con una probabilidad superior al 90% de que haya un fenómeno muy intenso durante el otoño boreal y el invierno boreal de 2026-27 en el hemisferio norte, informó el jueves el Centro de Predicción Climática de Estados Unidos. "Durante la temporada de octubre a diciembre de 2026, hay un 75% de probabilidad de un fenómeno histórico que superaría la intensidad de los fenómenos de El Niño anteriores, que se remontan a 1950", añadió el servicio de predicción meteorológica. El Niño es un fenómeno meteorológico que ocurre de forma natural cuando el debilitamiento de los vientos alisios provoca una acumulación de aguas oceánicas más cálidas en el Pacífico ecuatorial central y oriental. El fenómeno suele provocar un aumento de las temperaturas globales y alteraciones en los patrones meteorológicos, lo que conlleva sequías en algunas regiones y fuertes lluvias en otras. "El actual fenómeno de El Niño es intenso y seguirá intensificándose en los próximos meses, por lo que se convertirá en el más intenso jamás registrado", dijo Jason Nicholls, jefe de previsiones internacionales de AccuWeather. La sequía provocada por El Niño ha devastado los cultivos de maíz y frijoles en todo el Corredor Seco de Centroamérica, lo que ha sumido a decenas de miles de hogares rurales en una mayor inseguridad alimentaria e hídrica, según Oxfam. "Actualmente estamos observando condiciones más secas en toda América Central, y esto debería continuar durante los próximos meses mientras nos encontremos bajo la influencia de El Niño", dijo Donald Keeney, meteorólogo agrícola de Vaisala Weather en Finlandia.

item.content:encoded: Die vom Iran unterstützten Huthi-Rebellen haben im Jemen die strategisch wichtige Hafenstadt Mokka unter ihre Kontrolle gebracht. Dies erfuhr die Nachrichtenagentur Reuters am Donnerstag aus Militärkreisen. Damit weiten die Rebellen ihren Einfluss auf die Meerenge Bab al-Mandab aus, die als eine der wichtigsten Schifffahrtsrouten der Welt gilt. Zudem griffen die Huthis die militärisch bedeutsamen Hanisch-Inseln an und landeten dort Regierungsangaben zufolge. Die Sorge vor einer Blockade der Seewege ließ den Preis für die Rohölsorte Brent am Donnerstag um 3,5 Prozent auf über 100 Dollar pro Barrel steigen. Huthi-Sprecher Mohammed Abdulsalam erklärte am Donnerstag auf der Plattform X, die Schifffahrt und der internationale Handel im Roten Meer und in der Meerenge Bab al-Mandab seien weiterhin sicher. Der Jemen stelle keine Bedrohung für den Schiffsverkehr dar. Die Einsätze der Huthis seien defensiv und beschränkten sich auf zuvor angekündigte Ziele. Die Aktionen würden eingestellt, sobald die Angriffe auf den Jemen endeten und die Blockade aufgehoben würde. FÜR SAUDI-ARABIEN BESONDERS WICHTIG Die Meerenge Bab al-Mandab liegt zwischen dem Jemen auf der Arabischen Halbinsel einerseits und Dschibuti sowie Eritrea an der afrikanischen Küste andererseits. Sie ist eine Hauptroute für Rohöl und Treibstoff aus der Golfregion in Richtung Mittelmeer und Asien. Für Saudi-Arabien ist der Seeweg durch das Rote Meer besonders wichtig, da die Straße von Hormus wegen des Konflikts zwischen den USA und dem Iran weitgehend blockiert ist. Die jemenitischen Regierungstruppen zogen sich den Angaben zufolge nach Süden in Richtung Dhubab zurück, um die Kontrolle über die Meerenge zu sichern. Die Kämpfe zwischen Saudi-Arabien und den Huthis eskalierten zuletzt weiter. Die saudi-arabischen Behörden lösten am Donnerstag in der südwestlichen Stadt Chamis Muschait wegen anhaltender Angriffe der Miliz viermal innerhalb von 24 Stunden Luftalarm aus. Um eine weitere Eskalation zu verhindern, übermittelte Pakistan eine saudi-arabische Aufforderung an den Iran, mäßigend auf die Huthis einzuwirken. Ein hochrangiger iranischer Vertreter bestätigte den Erhalt der Botschaft am Dienstag, erklärte jedoch, der Iran kontrolliere die Huthis nicht. Die Rebellen hatten sich im März aufseiten des Iran am Krieg beteiligt und im Juli eine Seeblockade gegen Saudi-Arabien verhängt.

item.title: Europe's space chief raises need for the region to coordinate its satellite plans
item.description: Europe must ensure its countries' competing satellite programmes can work together effectively and do not duplicate each other, European Space Agency Director General Josef Aschbacher said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Florence Loeve
item.content:encoded: Europe must ensure its countries' competing satellite programmes can work together effectively and do not duplicate each other, European Space Agency Director General Josef Aschbacher said on Thursday. He was speaking at a [USN:L1N4510PW TEXT:"space summit"] in Paris, where new contracts for the European Union's IRIS² planned communications constellation were announced, bolstering efforts to create an alternative to non-European actors, most notably Elon Musk's SpaceX (SPCX.O) . Referring to separate national programmes, Aschbacher told Reuters on the sidelines of the summit that it was important to avoid them becoming silos. "If we are able to connect them, then it is actually a very powerful system," he said. "Under the condition that interoperability is implemented and is materialised. And this, of course, has yet to be done." IRIS²'s rollout includes initial launches in 2029. Germany's pursuit of a separate national military satellite network has added to concerns about [USN:L8N3ZU1DN TEXT:"fragmentation of European efforts"] and rising costs. Aschbacher said the European Space Agency, which has a central role in IRIS²'s implementation, has held technical meetings with industry players to define requirements for interoperability. FRANCO-ITALIAN JOINT VENTURE'S DEAL On the second and final day of [USN:L8N44Z12P TEXT:"the French-hosted summit"], Thales Alenia Space said it had signed an agreement with satellite operator Eutelsat to supply government payloads for 330 of IRIS²'s low-Earth-orbit satellites, while Airbus (AIR.PA) said it would build the first layer composed of at least 66 satellites. Thales Alenia Space, a joint venture between France's Thales (TCFP.PA) and Italy's Leonardo (LDOF.MI) , said the order made up around €500 million ($582 million) of a broader IRIS² contract expected to exceed €3 billion. Aschbacher also said he was encouraged by strong political support from member states for plans that could eventually allow Europe to launch its own astronauts rather than relying on U.S. spacecraft. In a proposal published during the summit, he called for investment of €1 billion a year for 10 years starting in 2029 to strengthen European autonomy in the space sector. A decision on whether to approve the proposal would be taken in 2028, in line with ESA procedures. French President Emmanuel Macron used the summit to call for greater European coordination and for European governments to direct public procurement at European companies. He said, however, that need not rule out partnerships with foreign companies, including U.S. firms.

item.title: Macy's erhöht dank Luxusketten Umsatz- und Gewinnprognose
item.description: Die US-Kaufhauskette Macy's hat dank seiner Luxusketten Bloomingdale's und Bluemercury seine Umsatz- und Gewinnprognose leicht angehoben. Trotz des unsicheren wirtschaftlichen Umfelds geben einkommensstarke Verbraucher dort weiter Geld aus.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die US-Kaufhauskette Macy's (M.N) hat dank seiner Luxusketten Bloomingdale's und Bluemercury seine Umsatz- und Gewinnprognose leicht angehoben. Trotz des unsicheren wirtschaftlichen Umfelds geben einkommensstarke Verbraucher dort weiter Geld aus. Unter Konzernchef Tony Spring setzt Macy's verstärkt auf den Premiumbereich mit Bekleidung, Handtaschen, Parfüms und Hautpflegeprodukten. Das Wachstum in den Macy's-Filialen, die eine breitere Kundschaft ansprechen sollen, hinkt dagegen hinterher. Spring setzt mit seiner Strategie "Bold New Chapter" auch auf profitablere Produkte ohne Rabatte. Zudem werden unrentable Filialen geschlossen. Macy's rechnet nun im Gesamtjahr mit einem Umsatz zwischen 21,68 und 21,83 Milliarden Dollar, während vorher zwischen 21,50 und 21,75 Milliarden erwartet wurden. Der Gewinn je Aktie soll zwischen 2,15 bis 2,35 Dollar statt 2,00 bis 2,20 Dollar liegen. Im zurückliegen Geschäftsquartal steigerte der Konzern seinen Umsatz um 1,1 Prozent auf 4,87 Milliarden Dollar im Vergleich zum Vorjahresquartal. Dies übertraf die Analystenschätzung von 4,83 Milliarden. Der flächenbereinigte Umsatz von Bloomingdale's stieg um 11,3 Prozent. Bei der Kosmetikkette Bluemercury legte er um 6,2 Prozent zu. In den Macy's-Filialen betrug das Plus dagegen nur 1,1 Prozent. Der bereinigte Gewinn von 40 Cent je Aktie - ohne Berücksichtigung von Zollrückerstattungen - übertraf die Analystenschätzung von 37 Cent.

item.title: Hungary's central bank may add climate risk scenarios to policy framework
item.description: Hungary's drought and a likely rebound in global food prices could push up inflation next year, central bank Deputy Governor Zoltan Kurali said on Thursday, adding the bank was considering adding climate risk scenarios to its decision-making framework.
item.dc:creator: Gergely Szakacs
item.content:encoded: Hungary's drought and a likely rebound in global food prices could push up inflation next year, central bank Deputy Governor Zoltan Kurali said on Thursday, adding the bank was considering adding climate risk scenarios to its decision-making framework. Record heatwaves and chronic water shortages are [USN:L8N44T097 TEXT:"shrinking maize harvests"] across central and eastern Europe, forcing some farmers to abandon the crop and reshaping a region long viewed as a cornerstone of European grain production. Hungary's Meteorological Service said on Monday the country received its lowest summer rainfall since the start of the 20th century, while median temperatures were the second-highest behind 2024, dealing a blow to agriculture. "The climate effects of the past few years cannot be described along the lines of normal developments," Kurali told an economics conference. "Rather extreme things have played out." He said this year's drought could take a substantial toll on agriculture, hitting the economy and likely adding to price pressures next year from global factors including El Nino and rising food prices driven by higher fuel and fertiliser costs. "The food price trend, which has also contributed significantly to the decline in (Hungarian) inflation, is not necessarily sustainable," Kurali said, referring to previous falls in food prices. The bank, which cut its base rate by 25 basis points to 5.5% last month, as expected, will hold its next policy meeting on September 22, when it is also due to publish updated quarterly forecasts. "We are considering taking the climate issue to the next level in central bank deliberations," Kurali said. He said this would involve permanently incorporating a climate-risk scenario into policymaking and assessing its impact on growth and inflation. However, he highlighted methodological challenges because climate models typically cover much longer periods than the central bank's 18- to 24-month policy horizon.

item.title: Wall Street recua após dados de inflação ao produtor acima do esperado
item.description: Os principais índices de Wall Street registravam queda nesta quinta-feira, depois que os dados sobre os preços ao produtor de agosto aumentaram as expectativas de uma alta da taxa de juros neste mês, enquanto o agravamento do conflito no Oriente Médio mantinha os preços do petróleo acima de US$100 por barril.
item.dc:creator: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Niket Nishant
item.content:encoded: Os principais índices de Wall Street registravam queda nesta quinta-feira, depois que os dados sobre os preços ao produtor de agosto aumentaram as expectativas de uma alta da taxa de juros neste mês, enquanto o agravamento do conflito no Oriente Médio mantinha os preços do petróleo acima de US$100 por barril. O petróleo Brent subia 3,28%, para mais de US$100 por barril, afetando as perspectivas para o mercado de ações e reforçando as expectativas de que a taxa de juros possa ser elevada neste mês, já que as rotas de abastecimento tanto pelo Estreito de Ormuz quanto pelo Mar Vermelho continuam fortemente prejudicadas pela guerra que já dura seis meses e que tem mostrado poucos sinais de abrandamento. Refletindo esse aumento nos custos, um relatório do Departamento do Trabalho mostrou que o índice de preços ao produtor subiu 5,4% em agosto em base anualizada, um pouco acima dos 5,3% esperados pelos economistas consultados pela Reuters. Embora esse relatório normalmente receba menos atenção do que o índice de preços ao consumidor, que será publicado na sexta-feira, todos os indicadores econômicos estão sob maior escrutínio desde que o banco central deixou de divulgar orientações sobre a política monetária. “Esperávamos que os dados fossem mais fracos do que as expectativas. Não foram fracos o suficiente”, disse Jim Lebenthal, estrategista-chefe de ações da Cerity Partners. “Agora, estamos meio que torcendo por um milagre com os preços ao consumidor amanhã.” Os rendimentos dos Treasuries de dois anos, que acompanham de perto as expectativas da taxa de juros, saltaram para 4,516%, o nível mais alto desde 2024. Os operadores agora avaliam em 69,8% a chance de o Federal Reserve aumentar a taxa de juros em pelo menos 25 pontos-base na próxima semana, ante cerca de 64% antes do relatório desta quinta-feira, segundo a ferramenta CME FedWatch. O Índice Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) caía 0,60%, para 52.067,74 pontos, enquanto o S&P 500 (.SPX) perdia 0,72%, a 7.581,17 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) tinha queda de 0,86%, para 26.026,49 pontos. O setor de bens de consumo básico (.SPLRCS) registrava alta de 0,09%, refletindo uma tendência cautelosa em direção a setores defensivos, conforme os investidores avaliavam as perspectivas de inflação e a possibilidade de novos aumentos nas taxas de juros. (Reportagem de Niket Nishant, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi e Johann M Cherian em Bengaluru)

item.title: US to issue $500 Obamacare refunds to nearly a million Americans
item.description: The White House said on Thursday nearly 1 million Americans enrolled under Obamacare plans will receive $500 payments as the Trump administration moves to refund excess fees charged through the federal marketplace.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The White House said on Thursday nearly 1 million Americans enrolled under Obamacare plans will receive $500 payments as the Trump administration moves to refund excess fees charged through the federal marketplace. Checks will be sent to eligible Americans starting October. President Donald Trump has also [USN:L1N45203G TEXT:"proposed to pay"] every U.S. adult a $5,000 "Trump dividend" if his party wins the November congressional elections, at a time when opinion polls show his popularity at an all-time low with broad majorities dissatisfied with the Iran war and the U.S. economy. Obamacare plans, created by former President Barack Obama's signature Affordable Care Act, are subsidized based on income. The White House said the Biden Administration overcharged Americans through Obamacare plan exchange "user fees" that were passed on to consumers in the form of higher premiums. "In many cases, these refunds will cover the entire spike in your insurance caused by Democrats, who solely work to protect big insurance companies," Trump said in a video posted by the White House on social media platform X. "Our administration is doing the right thing and giving the money back to the people who were wrongly ripped off." The refunds would go to consumers in 30 states who do not receive premium subsidies and purchased coverage through the federal marketplace, called Healthcare.gov, where people sign up for the plans. The states, many of which are Republican-led, are Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Hawaii, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Louisiana, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, New Hampshire, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming. Healthcare costs have increased for the subsidized plans after Congress allowed COVID-19-era tax credits to expire. Trump has repeatedly criticized the Affordable Care Act. The administration has previously proposed new Obamacare rules for 2027, allowing insurers to offer new kinds of long-term catastrophic policies, plans with low premiums but significantly higher out-of-pocket costs that would be used to cover major medical expenses.

item.title: Mercados argentinos operan selectivos por cuestiones domésticas
item.description: La plaza financiera argentina operaba con cautela el jueves mientras los inversores esperan el resultado del dato de inflación de agosto y la próxima licitación de letras del Tesoro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La plaza financiera argentina operaba con cautela el jueves mientras los inversores esperan el resultado del dato de inflación de agosto y la próxima licitación de letras del Tesoro. El Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Censos (INDEC) informará el dato oficial del Índice de Precios al Consumidor (IPC) del octavo mes del año a las 1600 hora local (1900 GMT). El consenso del mercado espera un dato de 1,7%, según arrojó un reciente [USN:L1N4510HU TEXT:"sondeo de Reuters"], que coincidió con el [USN:L1N44W0F4 TEXT:"Relevamiento de Expectativas de Mercado (REM)"] del banco central argentino (BCRA). "Las estimaciones del mercado apuntan a una cifra por debajo del 2%. Esta proyección coincide con el reciente dato de la ciudad de Buenos Aires, que registró una suba del 1,7%", expresó la consultora Wise Capital. "No descartamos que agosto cierre en 1,6%", agregó Wise Capital y proyectó que "hacia adelante, la inflación se mantendrá en un rango de entre 1,5% y 2%". Otro factor que impactaba en los inversores es la próxima licitación de títulos del Tesoro argentino, que se realizará el viernes, para renovar vencimientos de deuda en moneda local por unos 8,13 billones de pesos. "El Gobierno repite la estrategia utilizada en las últimas dos licitaciones, ofreciendo únicamente bonos que vencen durante la actual administración y limitando la nueva emisión de bonos largos en pesos para evitar una mayor prima por plazo en un contexto de aparente exceso de oferta", dijo la consultora Max Capital. El Tesoro nacional ofrecerá seis títulos que tendrán vencimiento entre octubre de este año y noviembre del 2027. Los bonos en el mercado extrabursátil operaban el jueves con mejoras de 0,1% en promedio, mientras que el riesgo país argentino se ubicaba en los 491 puntos básicos. Por su parte, el S&P Merval (.MERV) de la Bolsa de Buenos Aires avanzaba un 0,37% a las 1425 GMT. La petrolera estatal YPF (YPFDm.BA) colocó [USN:L6N4511DG TEXT:"un bono al 2035 por 1.200 millones de dólares"], según dio a conocer el miércoles tras el cierre del mercado. "La emisión (de YPF) fue la mayor de la compañía desde abril de 2015" explicó Max Capital. "La emisión de YPF también forma parte de una estrategia de manejo de pasivos, ya que la compañía lanzó una oferta de recompra por hasta 500 millones de dólares de bonos con vencimiento en 2027 y 2029", agregó. La moneda nacional, el peso, se negociaba en el mercado interbancario con una depreciación de apenas 0,07% a 1.515 unidades por dólar. El peso argentino tocó su nivel mínimo intradiario en la sesión previa al marcar las 1.517,5 unidades para la venta.

item.title: ECB's Lagarde rejects French far-left leader's debt-cancellation plan as 'financially dangerous'
item.description: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde on Thursday rejected French far-left leader Jean-Luc Mélenchon's plan to cancel a portion of France's national debt, calling it "financially dangerous" and legally impossible under EU law.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde on Thursday rejected French far-left leader [USN:L8N44L1BW TEXT:"Jean-Luc Mélenchon's plan"] to cancel a portion of France's national debt, calling it "financially dangerous" and legally impossible under EU law. Mélenchon has proposed cancelling 18% of France's debt, which he says is held by the Bank of France, arguing the move would free up fiscal space for social spending as France's debt burden tops 116% of the country's economic output. Asked directly about the idea, Lagarde said creditors would punish such a move. Comparing public debt to a personal loan, she said if a borrower refused to repay and then sought new financing, "I'm not going to finance you," adding she would instead "significantly increase the interest rate" charged. "Really not a good idea and a large waste of time, however popular that could be in any member state in the euro area," she said at the ECB's regular press conference after [USN:L1N452054 TEXT:"raising interest rates"]. Lagarde, who is herself a former French economy and finance minister, also said debt cancellation is barred under Article 123 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union — one of the European Union's founding treaties. She called the treaty "a pillar of stability" and said that any effort to circumvent debt financing rules "would be a pure violation of the treaty".

item.title: China's Spic signs deal for $272 million Brazil hydro plant expansion
item.description: Spic Brasil, a subsidiary of China's State Power Investment Corporation, has signed a contract with a Chinese consortium to expand the Sao Simao hydroelectric plant for 1.4 billion reais ($272.30 million), the power generator said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Spic Brasil, a subsidiary of China's State Power Investment Corporation, has signed a contract with a Chinese consortium to expand the Sao Simao hydroelectric plant for 1.4 billion reais ($272.30 million), the power generator said on Thursday. • The consortium, comprising Dongfang Electric Corporation and China Gezhouba Group, won a competitive process run by Spic for the 310-megawatt expansion awarded at Brazil's capacity auction in March. • With the new unit expected to begin commercial operations in 2030, the plant located on the Minas Gerais-Goias state border will exceed 2 gigawatts of installed capacity. • The March auction was the first opportunity in several years for new hydroelectric projects in Brazil. • Optimization of existing assets is the most efficient and sustainable way to expand the country's renewable and secure energy capacity, Spic Brasil CEO Adriana Waltrick said in a statement. ($1 = 5.1413 reais)

item.title: Playing the game
item.description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is talking a good game with financial markets. "I have asymmetric information. I am the house now," he said this week. "And you can bet against me if you want."
item.dc:creator: Carmel Crimmins
item.content:encoded: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is [USN:L1N451007 TEXT:"talking"] a good game with financial markets. "I have asymmetric information. I am the house now," he said this week. "And you can bet against me if you want." Bessent's comments come after an unusual joint U.S.-Japan intervention in the yen over the summer. He maintains that he has information that traders don’t have. In game theory, that’s known as asymmetric information. When it comes to the Japanese currency, things are going Bessent’s way. It’s [USN:L4N45007Z TEXT:"rallying"] ahead of an expected interest rate hike from the Bank of Japan next week. But in the bond market, not so much. Bessent has supersized Treasury buybacks to try and get yields down but it’s not working. Benchmark 10-year Treasury yields reached their [USN:L6N4510YV TEXT:"highest levels"] since 2023 this week. Asymmetric information is helpful, but in the bond market, [USN:L1N4510TE TEXT:"size matters"] too and a $6 billion intervention in a $32 trillion market doesn’t count for much. As columnist Jamie McGeever points out, the U.S. bond market [USN:L6N44Z0W3 TEXT:"is working"] exactly as it should. The economy is growing, the labour market is in good shape, inflation is stubbornly over the Fed’s 2% target and the budget deficit is expected to widen further – and that’s before anyone does the maths on U.S. President Donald [USN:L1N45203G TEXT:"Trump’s pledge"] to pay Americans $5,000 each if the Republicans retain control of Congress after November. Crucially for the bond and oil markets, the Iran war looks set to [USN:L6N45203X TEXT:"drag on"] for months, and that’s going to be bad for inflation. Benchmark oil prices are back above $100 a barrel and U.S. diesel prices, a key pressure point for U.S. farmers and businesses, hit [USN:L6N44V1CG TEXT:"record highs"]. Researchers at Anthropic are warning that there is a greater than 10% chance AI “could kill all humans”. The comments have gone viral and shine a light, once again, on the risks around AI. Reuters is [USN:L6N4510WC TEXT:"reporting "]this week that AI agents’ rogue activity is worse than previously thought with agents unleashed by OpenAI using at least 10 more sites for unauthorized communications than previously known. OpenAI is now pushing for mandatory national AI [USN:L6N4511GE TEXT:"safety requirements"]. And while AI grabs the headlines, I explore the economics of quantum computing in the latest episode of Reuters Econ World podcast. Watch it here . If you turn off that pipeline and turn it up and turn it down, you can't expect to see things changing at the frontier of the research," said Jonathan Ruane, senior lecturer in Global Economics and Management at MIT Sloan. On this week's Reuters Econ World podcast, we dive into the economics of quantum computing. Who is going to pay for this technology and will it live up to its revolutionary promise? Watch it here . item.title: Jean Smart e Harrison Ford podem alcançar marcos no Emmy em meio à turbulência em Hollywood
item.description: A estrela de “Medíocres” Jean Smart pode se tornar a primeira atriz a ganhar o Emmy de melhor atriz em série de comédia em todas as temporadas de exibição da série, enquanto Harrison Ford pode conquistar seu primeiro Emmy aos 84 anos por “Falando a Real” na cerimônia do Primetime Emmy Awards na segunda-feira.
item.dc:creator: Lisa Richwine
